clothChecks: All nine frozen Pass 1 files and all unrelated source files match SHA-256; approved asset/paint/geometry factories and Pass 3 tree profiles remain untouched.
Cloth subdivision preserves resting bounds and surface area; shoulder vertices remain anchored, hem responds, and reduced motion restores every resting vertex.
Cloth spring settling agrees at 15, 30, 60 and 120 Hz.

cleanup.limits: Five reset/remount cycles (three Medium plus High/Low), including Medium/High resize; not a long-session soak. Heap excludes native audio/GPU memory. AI timing excludes rendering and is not FPS. The shared Three Sprite geometry and the VSM shadow blur triangle remain engine caches; all scene-owned geometry disposes and the old GL context is destroyed.

liveBrowser.limit: One software-WebGL browser, Low quality, actual held ground pointer for twenty wall-clock seconds. Movement uses short collision substeps; elapsed time is capped at 250 ms for long stalls/resumes. Rendering below 4 FPS still slows simulation. This records live responsiveness, not accelerated simulation or physical GPU performance.
